fokukac_01.name: Chief Worm (Főkukac)
fokukac_01.description: A mini-statue of the iconic companion of The Great Ho-Ho-Ho Fisherman, the Chief Worm. This is Mihály Kolodko's very first public mini-statue in Budapest, created in memory of the artist's favorite childhood Hungarian cartoon series (created by István Csukás and Ferenc Sajdik). The original version of the statue stands in Uzhhorod, on the banks of the Uzh River.
fokukac_01.funFact: One of the most beloved statues among Budapest residents: on cold winter days, passers-by and fans regularly dress it up in crocheted or knitted tiny hats, scarves, and sometimes sweaters. It is one of the few statues that has a twin brother in Transcarpathia.
fokukac_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Go to Bem Quay, in line with the Halász Street tram stop.

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the low stone parapet separating the bike path from the pedestrian promenade.

Step 3 (Exact location): The statue sits on the smooth top of the stone parapet at knee height, facing the Danube (the Parliament).

kockasfulu_01.name: The Checkered-Eared Rabbit
kockasfulu_01.description: A bronze mini-statue of Veronika Marék's legendary cartoon character, the Checkered-Eared Rabbit. The cartoon hero observes the city from above, exactly as it did in the cartoons: looking through its telescope to find children in trouble and adventures to solve on the Pest side.
kockasfulu_01.funFact: It is a common custom among tourists and locals to stroke the rabbit's ear or telescope for good luck, which is why the bronze surface is polished bright in these areas. The statue offers a wonderful panorama of the Chain Bridge and the Parliament.
kockasfulu_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Go up to the Buda Castle District, to Szent György Square.

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the upper station of the Buda Castle Funicular and the stone railing in front of the Sándor Palace.

Step 3 (Exact location): It sits on top of the stone railing, near the Turul statue, facing the Pest side.

rubik_01.name: Rubik's Cube
rubik_01.description: It commemorates Ernő Rubik's 1974 world patent, the Magic Cube (Rubik's Cube). The mini-statue is a global symbol of Hungarian creativity and engineering genius, of which over 450 million units have been sold worldwide.
rubik_01.funFact: The surface of the statue is designed to look like a partially solved cube in the middle of being turned, rolling down the railing of the quay's stone stairs. When designing it, the artist intentionally chose the side facing the Parliament.
rubik_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Walk along Bem Quay, on the section between Batthyány Square and Margaret Bridge.

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the lower quay stone stairs leading towards the Danube in line with Vám Street.

Step 3 (Exact location): The statue lies on top of the stone railing of the stairs, exactly opposite the Parliament.

sad_tank_01.name: Sad Tank
sad_tank_01.description: The miniature tank with its drooping gun barrel is a silent memento of the 1956 Revolution and War of Independence. The military machine, tamed into helplessness and sadness, draws attention to the pointlessness of war and the power of the desire for freedom.
sad_tank_01.funFact: Originally, it had the famous slogan of the revolution 'Ruszkik haza!' (Russians go home!) written on its side. The first statue was stolen, so Kolodko recast it and put it back with reinforced fastening. An interesting feature is that the artist's signature can be found on it in tiny letters.
sad_tank_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Go to Bem Quay, slightly north of the Batthyány Square tram stop.

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the large, white memorial stone of the former Kossuth Bridge on the promenade.

Step 3 (Exact location): It is located right next to the memorial stone, on top of the stone parapet facing the Danube.

mekk_elek_01.name: Elek Mekk
mekk_elek_01.description: The bungling handyman of József Romhányi and József Nepp's classic puppet series, Elek Mekk (Master Mekk). The statue holds a street sign reading 'Moszkva tér' (Moscow Square), commemorating the iconic former name of Széll Kálmán Square.
mekk_elek_01.funFact: The Moscow Square sign has been broken off or damaged from the statue's hands several times, but the artist has replaced it every time. In winter, local residents often give him a tiny knitted scarf.
mekk_elek_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Travel to Széll Kálmán Square.

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the escalators leading towards Várfok Street (and the bus stops).

Step 3 (Exact location): He sits at the base of the stone wall, by the bottom step of the pedestrian stone stairs running next to the escalators.

kermit_01.name: Kermit the Frog
kermit_01.description: A bronze mini-statue of the Muppet Show's green frog, Kermit. The cartoon hero sits on the stone base of a fence as if cheerfully watching the square's wildlife and the people sitting on the café terrace.
kermit_01.funFact: Kermit was intentionally placed close to the trees and grass, referring to the frog's natural habitat. During cold winter months, he frequently receives a tiny, hand-knitted scarf or hat from visitors.
kermit_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Walk into Szabadság Square in the 5th district.

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the low metal fence surrounding the grassy area in the middle of the square, near the park café's terrace.

Step 3 (Exact location): He sits on the stone pedestal under the metal fence, as if watching the passers-by.

susu_01.name: Süsü, the Dragon
susu_01.description: A mini-statue of István Csukás's legendary one-headed dragon, Süsü. The figure faithfully evokes the classic Hungarian Television puppet show that defined the childhoods of generations.
susu_01.funFact: The first Süsü mini-statue was stolen from its place by unknown perpetrators, but Mihály Kolodko recast it and reinstalled it with reinforced fastening. The choice of location is symbolic because the Exchange Palace (Tőzsdepalota) standing on Szabadság Square was the headquarters of the Hungarian Television for decades.
susu_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Go to Szabadság Square in the 5th district.

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the grandiose main staircase of the former Hungarian Television headquarters (Exchange Palace).

Step 3 (Exact location): It stands on the thick stone railing on the left side of the stairs, facing the middle of the square.

diver_01.name: The Diver and the Key
diver_01.location: Corner of Osvát Street and Dohány Street
diver_01.description: The statue immortalizes Ferenc Molnár's famous coffeehouse legend. According to the story, when the New York Café opened in 1894, the writer threw its entrance key into the Danube so that the café could never close again. The figure in the old diving suit has now brought this key up from the bottom of the water.
diver_01.funFact: The sculptor intentionally designed the key to be almost the same size as the diver figure itself. Remembering the legend, in 2014, on the 120th anniversary of the café, the current management also threw a key into the Danube.
diver_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Head to the 7th district, the street section behind the famous New York Palace (café).

Step 2 (Focus): Find the corner of Osvát Street and Dohány Street.

Step 3 (Exact location): It is located on top of a gray, carved stone pillar (shaped like a fire hydrant) standing on the corner.

dracula_01.name: Dracula reading (Béla Lugosi)
dracula_01.description: A mini-statue of Hungarian Hollywood actor Béla Lugosi's legendary Dracula character, reading a book peacefully with a lowered head. The Gothic-style park environment provides a perfect background to evoke the famous vampire figure.
dracula_01.funFact: The placement of the statue is no accident: since 2003, there has also been a bust of Béla Lugosi (created by Hartmut Zech) secretly placed at night in the wall of Vajdahunyad Castle. The artist's signature can be found on the back of Kolodko's Dracula cape.
dracula_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Walk into the City Park (Városliget), around the area of Vajdahunyad Castle.

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the side of the castle facing the lake, specifically the wall section (alcove) behind the Hunyadi statue.

Step 3 (Exact location): It's worth looking up: he sits on a Gothic stone ledge, above eye level.

noah_ark_01.name: Noah's Ark
noah_ark_01.description: A miniature bronze replica of Noah's Ark. The artwork is a symbol of biblical salvation and the protection of wildlife, fitting perfectly into the university environment.
noah_ark_01.funFact: Looking through the tiny windows and openings of the ark, you can see pairs of tiny animal figures inside. In sunny weather, when the light hits the inside of the ark at the right angle, a colorful reflection (rainbow effect) appears inside the statue.
noah_ark_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Visit Bethlen Gábor Square in the 7th district.

Step 2 (Focus): Go to the side of the square facing the University of Veterinary Medicine, where there is a small decorative pool.

Step 3 (Exact location): The tiny ark rests on the edge of the low stone ledge surrounding the decorative pool.

liszt_ferenc_01.name: Ferenc Liszt waiting
liszt_ferenc_01.description: A mini-statue of the world-famous composer and pianist Ferenc Liszt. The statue combines the motif of flying and traveling with classical music: the artist sits on a piece of luggage waiting, while folding a paper airplane.
liszt_ferenc_01.funFact: Ferenc Liszt was a true 'global superstar' of his time, who constantly toured and traveled all over Europe. With this figure, Kolodko connected 19th-century travels with modern air transport and the international airport named after him.
liszt_ferenc_01.howToFind:
ATTENTION: The statue has been moved inside the building and is currently ONLY accessible with a valid boarding pass (after passing security control)!

Step 1 (Area): After security check, walk through the Duty Free shop into the central SkyCourt hall.

Step 2 (Focus): Go up the escalator to the upper floor with restaurants/lounges, and look for the entrance to the MasterCard Lounge.

Step 3 (Exact location): The statue stands on a pedestal in front of the MasterCard Lounge entrance, as part of a bronze paper airplane installation.

herzl_01.name: Theodor Herzl and the bicycle
herzl_01.description: A mini-statue of Theodor Herzl, the writer, journalist, and visionary of the Zionist movement, with a bicycle. The statue commemorates one of the most influential figures in Jewish history, right near his birthplace.
herzl_01.funFact: The statue's design is based on a famous contemporary photograph showing Theodor Herzl with a bicycle. The artist fixed the statue to the streetlamp post as if the cyclist were riding down it.
herzl_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Go to the 7th district, to the corner of Dohány Street and Károly Boulevard.

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the pedestrian crossing next to the Dohány Street Synagogue.

Step 3 (Exact location): It is attached to the side of the thick metal lamppost standing by the zebra crossing, at waist height.

szenes_hanna_01.name: Hannah Szenes
szenes_hanna_01.description: A memorial to Hannah Szenes, a Hungarian-Jewish poet and British paratrooper war hero who died a martyr at the age of 23. The statue depicts the heroine in parachute gear, emerging from a rock face, who sacrificed her life to save Hungarian Jews.
szenes_hanna_01.funFact: This is Kolodko's statue with the saddest backstory, unveiled on March 8, 2020, International Women's Day, in collaboration with the 'Hosszúlépés. Járunk?' organization, drawing attention to the painful absence of women in public sculpture. Hannah Szenes and lyricist Iván Szenes were cousins.
szenes_hanna_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Find Szenes Hanna Park in the 7th district (at the corner of Jósika Street and Rózsa Street).

Step 2 (Focus): Walk into the small grassy, wooded area of the park.

Step 3 (Exact location): It stands on the top/side of a cone-like pile of stones and bricks created in the park.

seress_rezso_01.name: Rezső Seress
seress_rezso_01.description: It commemorates Rezső Seress, the composer and pianist of the world-famous 'Gloomy Sunday'. The mini-statue depicts the artist sitting on a stone plaque/piano shaped like a pipe.
seress_rezso_01.funFact: The statue was placed on the wall of the former Kispipa restaurant, where Seress played the piano every night for decades. Because of him, world stars such as Louis Armstrong, Spencer Tracy, Marcello Mastroianni, or John Steinbeck visited Akácfa Street.
seress_rezso_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Walk to Akácfa Street 38 in the 7th district.

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the facade of the building that used to be the Kispipa restaurant (now operating under a different name).

Step 3 (Exact location): It is located on a metal plaque/stone shaped like a pipe attached to the restaurant's outer brick wall, slightly above eye level.

rejto_car_01.name: The 14-Carat Car
rejto_car_01.description: It depicts the iconic car from Jenő Rejtő's (P. Howard) 1940 pulp novel 'The 14-Carat Car'. The statue takes a sharp turn on the stone rim, symbolizing speeding in the neighborhood of the writer's former residence.
rejto_car_01.funFact: The statue is not purely bronze: its windows and headlights actually received gold-plated polishing, referring to the car parts made of gold in the novel. Jenő Rejtő spent his childhood in the neighboring Rejtő Jenő Street.
rejto_car_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Head to Hevesi Sándor Square in the 7th district.

Step 2 (Focus): Stop at the spacious square in front of the main entrance of the Pesti Magyar Theater.

Step 3 (Exact location): The little car is speeding on the edge of one of the curved stone flower beds decorating the square.

mr_bean_teddy_01.name: Teddy, Mr. Bean's bear
mr_bean_teddy_01.description: A bronze mini-statue of Mr. Bean's loyal teddy bear, Teddy. The tiny bear was placed on the wall of the former British Embassy building, evoking the iconic figure of British comedy.
mr_bean_teddy_01.funFact: The placement of the statue is closely connected to the building's history: it previously housed the British Embassy. The mini-statue serves as a sweet memorial to British-Hungarian cultural relations.
mr_bean_teddy_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Visit Harmincad Street in the 5th district (close to Vörösmarty Square).

Step 2 (Focus): Stop at Harmincad Street 6, at the entrance of the former British Embassy.

Step 3 (Exact location): You will find it right next to the entrance on the marble wall, at a comfortable eye level, exactly where the embassy's official coat of arms used to be.

ratatouille_01.name: Ratatouille (The spray-painting rat)
ratatouille_01.description: Remy, the brilliant chef-rat from the Pixar animated film, holding a spray can. The figure is running up the wall creating graffiti, combining the world of fairy tales with modern street art.
ratatouille_01.funFact: The statue is also a tribute to the iconic rat motifs of the famous anonymous British street artist, Banksy. With this work, Kolodko blurs the boundaries between guerrilla art and classical sculpture.
ratatouille_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Go to the Buda bridgehead of the Elizabeth Bridge, to Döbrentei Square.

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the massive, gray stone bridge pillar at the pedestrian ramp under/next to the bridge.

Step 3 (Exact location): It is 'climbing' up the wall of the bridge pillar, roughly at eye level.

dreher_01.name: Antal Dreher on a beer barrel
dreher_01.description: A miniature portrait statue of Antal Dreher, the pioneer of Hungarian brewing, sitting proudly on a wooden barrel holding a beer in his hand.
dreher_01.funFact: Antal Dreher introduced Pilsner-style bottom-fermenting brewing to Hungary, and utilizing the cellar system of Kőbánya, he built one of the most modern breweries in Europe. The statue pays tribute to the factory's traditions.
dreher_01.howToFind:
ATTENTION: The statue is located in the CLOSED courtyard of the factory, so it can ONLY be viewed during a pre-booked Dreher beer tour / factory visit!

Step 1 (Area): Travel to the 10th district, to Jászberényi Road 7-11. (Dreher Brewery).

Step 2 (Focus): Enter through the main entrance of the factory towards the Beer Museum (only with a valid factory tour registration).

Step 3 (Exact location): It stands in the inner courtyard in front of the Beer Museum, on top of an exhibited wooden beer barrel.

soroslovak_01.name: Dray horses (Brewery horses)
soroslovak_01.description: A bronze mini-statue of two traditional draft horses pulling a beer cart. The statue evokes the atmosphere of the streets of old Budapest and the traditional way of delivering beer.
soroslovak_01.funFact: For decades, huge Dreher horses transported beer barrels to restaurants from the Dreher factory in Kőbánya. Out of respect for the horses, the factory provided them with their own stables and veterinary care.
soroslovak_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Travel to the 10th district, to Jászberényi Road 7-11. (Dreher Brewery).

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the outer parking lot OUTSIDE the factory fence and the area in front of the main entrance gate.

Step 3 (Exact location): The two horses are pulling the beer cart on the railing of the small limestone bridge outside the fence (freely accessible from the street).

skala_kope_01.name: Skála Kópé
skala_kope_01.description: A mini-statue of Skála Kópé, the most popular advertising figure in Hungary in the 80s. The ball-headed, heartwarming figure is the iconic mascot of domestic retro advertising history.
skala_kope_01.funFact: Skála Kópé's famous slogan was: 'I am Skála Kópé, my advertisement is the commercial!'. The date of the statue's unveiling intentionally fell on April 1st (April Fool's Day), referring to the figure's playful nature.
skala_kope_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Let's meet at the clock! Go to Nyugati Square in the 6th district.

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the open space in front of the former Skála Metró department store building, adjacent to the grand staircase.

Step 3 (Exact location): It is on the stone edge of the built-in flower bed next to the staircase.

vuk_01.name: Swinging Vuk
vuk_01.description: István Fekete's immortal little fox, Vuk, hanging helplessly and playfully from a World War II bomb sticking out of a rock face.
vuk_01.funFact: The statue refers to a serious historical background: Gellért Hill was a prominent strategic point and siege site during the Second World War. Kolodko contrasted the sweetness of a children's tale with the horrors of war.
vuk_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Walk along Szent Gellért Quay in the 1st district.

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the promenade section between the Rudas Bath and the Elizabeth Bridge at the foot of Gellért Hill.

Step 3 (Exact location): Look up! The little fox is hanging on a metal pipe (bomb) sticking out high from the rock face of the hill.

houdini_01.name: Harry Houdini
houdini_01.description: A mini-statue of the Budapest-born illusionist and escape artist Harry Houdini (Erik Weisz). The figure lies bound with chains and a padlock, as if preparing for his latest trick.
houdini_01.funFact: Houdini was born in Budapest in 1874 in the 7th district, and became the greatest escape artist the world has ever seen. The placement of the statue in the inner courtyard of the Erzsébetváros Cultural Center reminds us of the artist's roots.
houdini_01.howToFind:
ATTENTION: The statue is in the inner courtyard of K11, so it can only be visited during the opening hours of the K11 Art Center (on weekdays)!

Step 1 (Area): Go to Király Street 11. in the 7th district.

Step 2 (Focus): Enter the inner courtyard through the open gate of the K11 Art and Cultural Center.

Step 3 (Exact location): Look down! He lies bound at the base of one of the low stone walls of the courtyard.

columbo_mokus_01.name: Dead squirrel
columbo_mokus_01.description: A bronze mini-statue of a 'dead' squirrel surrounded by a forensic chalk outline on the ground. The statue is in direct dialogue with Lieutenant Columbo standing in the background.
columbo_mokus_01.funFact: The statue is an artistic reflection on the famous installation depicting a suicidal squirrel by contemporary Italian artist Maurizio Cattelan. With a humorous twist, Kolodko placed the victim of the mysterious 'crime' behind the legs of Lieutenant Columbo (Peter Falk).
columbo_mokus_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Go to the corner of Falk Miksa Street and Szent István Boulevard in the 5th district.

Step 2 (Focus): Find the life-size bronze statue of Lieutenant Columbo and his dog.

Step 3 (Exact location): Stand behind Columbo's back! The squirrel lies inside the chalk outline painted on the asphalt behind the lieutenant.

kotrabant_01.name: Stone Trabant
kotrabant_01.description: A Trabant 601 mini-statue carved out of a limestone block, equipped with a wind-up key. The artwork is an iconic symbol of the Eastern European retro lifestyle and nostalgia.
kotrabant_01.funFact: The statue is carved from a single block of limestone, except for the metal wind-up key on top, which tames the symbol of the socialist car industry into a toy car. The choice of location rhymes with the concrete architecture left over from socialism.
kotrabant_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Walk to the Buda bridgehead of Margaret Bridge (2nd district).

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the parking lot under the northern ramp of the bridge (the HÉV stop) and the edge of the promenade.

Step 3 (Exact location): It is carved out of an independent limestone block lying on the ground, only its wind-up key is metal.

delorean_trabant_01.name: Forward to the past (DeLorean Trabant)
delorean_trabant_01.description: A mini-statue of a Trabant equipped with the gull-wing doors of the iconic DeLorean time machine from the movie 'Back to the Future'. A brilliant fusion of retro and sci-fi.
delorean_trabant_01.funFact: The Keleti Railway Station is a symbol of journeys starting and ending in Budapest and 'traveling in time'. The statue combines Eastern European reality with the time-traveling myth of Western popular culture.
delorean_trabant_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Head to the 8th district, Baross Square (street level) in front of the Keleti Railway Station.

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the open area in front of the main entrance of the station, around the bus stops and the promenade.

Step 3 (Exact location): The little time machine is parked on the edge of a stone parapet/stone ledge on the surface (its top can be opened).

among_us_01.name: Stalin's boots / Among Us
among_us_01.description: A mini-statue depicting the remains of Stalin's destroyed giant statue in Budapest (the famous boots), from which a bone sticks out, referring to a dead character in the style of the popular video game Among Us. The artwork is also a visual pun on the Hungarian phrase 'lerágott csont' (chewed-up bone / beating a dead horse).
among_us_01.funFact: The statue connects the history of the 1956 revolution (when the people of Pest toppled the Stalin statue) with modern digital pop culture. The essence of the 'Among Us' game is hiding and unmasking the 'impostor'.
among_us_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Walk along Dózsa György Road on the edge of the City Park.

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the promenade next to the curved building of the new Museum of Ethnography (where the Parade Ground used to be).

Step 3 (Exact location): You will find the boots on top of a low stone bench (skateboard ledge), with the characteristic leg bone sticking out.

lufikutya_01.name: Balloon dog with bone (Libido)
lufikutya_01.description: A satirical Hungarian version of contemporary American artist Jeff Koons' world-famous 'Balloon Dog' artwork, staring at a giant bone on the bank of the Danube.
lufikutya_01.funFact: According to Kolodko, the statue is also titled 'Libido', implying that the bone attracts the dog like a woman attracts a man. The location is closely tied to Cicciolina (Ilona Staller), who was Jeff Koons' wife, and her career started in the neighboring InterContinental hotel.
lufikutya_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Walk along the Danube Promenade in the 5th district.

Step 2 (Focus): Stop at the promenade on the Danube side of the InterContinental Hotel.

Step 3 (Exact location): It is watching a bone on one of the cube-shaped fences bordering the promenade.

balta_01.name: Axe on a cushion
balta_01.description: A miniature axe resting on a decorative cushion. The statue is Kolodko's satirical and artistic response to the political incident when a Member of Parliament knocked the previous Ushanka statue off its place with an axe and threw it into the Danube.
balta_01.funFact: The artist was not offended by the vandalism but incorporated the reaction into the creative process: he offered the 'tool' to the destroyer. Later, in 2023, the Ushanka statue 'grew frog legs' and 'climbed out' of the Danube onto the quay.
balta_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Visit Szabadság Square in the 5th district.

Step 2 (Focus): Go to the Soviet military memorial in the northern part of the square, and observe the low wrought-iron fence surrounding it.

Step 3 (Exact location): It lies on top of one of the thick stone pillars of the fence (the Ushanka statue used to stand here).

usanka_02.name: Ushanka returns
usanka_02.description: The little brother of the Soviet ushanka that was previously thrown into the Danube, which grew frog legs, 'climbed out' of the river, and returned to the stairs of the Pest quay.
usanka_02.funFact: The statue is a direct continuation of the Ushanka incident in Szabadság Square. With this comic-book-like twist, Kolodko showed the indestructibility of art and his humorous response to public affairs.
usanka_02.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Walk down to the Id. Antall József Quay in the 5th district.

Step 2 (Focus): South of the Parliament, in line with József Attila Street, look for a set of stone stairs leading to the water.

Step 3 (Exact location): It stands on frog legs on the very bottom step of the stairs, right near the water of the Danube.

nincs_kompot_01.name: No compote!
nincs_kompot_01.description: A tiny composition referring to the iconic quote ('The Russians are already in the pantry!') and characters of the classic Hungarian comedy film 'The Corporal and the Others'.
nincs_kompot_01.funFact: The statue is hidden in a deep crack in a stone retaining wall, which makes it the hardest Kolodko statue to find and photograph in Budapest. The hiding itself symbolizes the hiding in the movie.
nincs_kompot_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Walk on the Várkert Quay in the 1st district (under the Várkert Bazár).

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the massive stone retaining wall on the Danube bank running next to the tram tracks.

Step 3 (Exact location): Keep your eyes wide open! It is hidden in one of the vertical, deep cracks of the stone retaining wall, you have to look between the stones.

kutyavasar_01.name: There was a dog market in Buda only once
kutyavasar_01.location: Batthyány Street 26. / Hattyú Street corner (Nevenincs Square)
kutyavasar_01.description: Six tiny bronze puppies (various Hungarian breeds, partly in a basket, partly nearby) and a King Matthias coin embedded in the ground. The statue group pays tribute to the famous Hungarian proverb and the folktale of King Matthias.
kutyavasar_01.funFact: According to the legend, King Matthias once bought a poor man's dogs for good money in Buda, but when the greedy rich also brought dogs to sell the next day, the king chased them away saying 'there was a dog market in Buda only once'. The coin is also related to this story.
kutyavasar_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Go to the corner of Batthyány Street and Hattyú Street in the 1st district (around Batthyány St. 26, the so-called Nevenincs Square).

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the small square / flower beds in front of the Vízivárosi Klub.

Step 3 (Exact location): The dogs are sitting on the stone edges and in a basket, while the coin is embedded in the paving stones near them.

romai_legios_01.name: In vino veritas (Roman legionary)
romai_legios_01.description: A Roman era soldier (legionary) leaning against a wine amphora, resting carelessly on the stone ruins of the ancient amphitheater. The title of the statue is: 'In vino veritas' (In wine there is truth).
romai_legios_01.funFact: The statue evokes the ancient Roman heritage of Aquincum. When designing it, the artist also cast a twin brother of it, which he placed at the Roman amphitheater in Pula, Croatia.
romai_legios_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Go to the 3rd district (Óbuda), to the Roman military amphitheater on Nagyszombat Street.

Step 2 (Focus): Walk around the grassy arena along the original Roman ruin stones.

Step 3 (Exact location): He is lying carelessly on top of one of the larger remaining stone blocks.

aranka_bela_01.name: Aunt Aranka and Uncle Béla
aranka_bela_01.description: The statue commemorates the iconic and beloved florist couple of Pasaréti Square, Aunt Aranka and Uncle Béla, who sold flowers at the local booth for decades.
aranka_bela_01.funFact: This is one of the most touching Kolodko statues, realized entirely through local community collaboration and public donations as a tribute to the couple's memory.
aranka_bela_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Travel to Pasaréti Square in the 2nd district.

Step 2 (Focus): Look around the neighborhood of the bus terminus and the former (now closed) flower booth.

Step 3 (Exact location): The couple sits on the edge of the low stone fence/flower bed next to the booth.

garfield_01.name: Garfield
garfield_01.description: A mini-statue of Jim Davis's world-famous comic book hero, the lazy and lasagna-loving cat Garfield, stretching comfortably on top of the brick wall.
garfield_01.funFact: The statue was created in 2023 for the 45th birthday of Garfield's creation. The fence of the University of Veterinary Medicine was chosen as the location because the institution is the center for healing small animals.
garfield_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Find Dembinszky Street 4 in the 7th district.

Step 2 (Focus): Stop at the high, red-brick fence of the University of Veterinary Medicine.

Step 3 (Exact location): It is located on one of the thick stone pillars of the fence.

roth_miksa_01.name: Miksa Róth
roth_miksa_01.description: A miniature bust of Miksa Róth, the world-famous Hungarian glass painter and mosaic artist. The statue is placed behind a stained glass window frame, evoking the master's life's work.
roth_miksa_01.funFact: The statue has a built-in tiny lamp that illuminates the window from behind, so regardless of the time of day, it creates the exact effect as if sunlight were shining through Miksa Róth's colored glass.
roth_miksa_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Go to Nefelejcs Street 26 in the 7th district.

Step 2 (Focus): Enter the Miksa Róth Memorial House and Collection (Attention: this is an INDOOR statue, only accessible during opening hours).

Step 3 (Exact location): It can be viewed on a period wooden piece of furniture (display cabinet) in the ground floor study.

lisa_simpson_02.name: Lisa Simpson (Hungarian Yellow)
lisa_simpson_02.description: A mini-statue of Lisa Simpson, the climate activist little girl from The Simpsons, chained to a yellow tram stop pole. The title of the statue is: 'Hungarian Yellow'.
lisa_simpson_02.funFact: The statue satirically refers to the civil disobedience actions of environmental activists, while the yellow color pays tribute to Budapest's iconic tram lines (2, 4, 6).
lisa_simpson_02.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Head from Fővám Square in the 9th district towards the Bálna building on the upper Danube bank promenade.

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the open end of the tram underpass towards the Bálna and the row of benches facing the Danube.

Step 3 (Exact location): She is chained to the pole at the very end of the metal railing separating the pedestrian promenade and the tram underpass (yellow statue).

ferenc_jozsef_01.name: Franz Joseph in a hammock
ferenc_jozsef_01.description: A mini-statue of Franz Joseph, Emperor of Austria and King of Hungary, resting in a comfortable hammock among the iron grids of the bridge named after him (today's Liberty Bridge).
ferenc_jozsef_01.funFact: The statue captures the relaxed and free atmosphere of the 'Szabihíd' summer picnics, when the public takes possession of the closed bridge. Franz Joseph personally drove the last silver rivet during the bridge's inauguration in 1896.
ferenc_jozsef_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Walk up onto the Liberty Bridge.

Step 2 (Focus): Stop at the section closer to the Pest bridgehead, and observe the green metal structure of the bridge above the pedestrian sidewalk.

Step 3 (Exact location): He lies in a tiny hammock stretched across one of the V-shaped support elements of the metal structure.

fules_01.name: Headphones
fules_01.description: A miniature bronze pair of headphones (studio headphones) resting on the railing of the Palace of Arts (Müpa), evoking the world of music and acoustics.
fules_01.funFact: The special feature of the statue is that at the time of its inauguration, it actually played music to passers-by using a built-in speaker. It is a symbol of the cultural district between Müpa and the National Theater.
fules_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Go to Komor Marcell Street 1 in the 9th district.

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the main entrance of the Palace of Arts (Müpa) facing the Danube.

Step 3 (Exact location): The headphones 'hang' on the metal railing of the wide staircase leading to the main entrance.

szurikata_01.name: Meerkat
szurikata_01.description: A mini-statue of an alert meerkat family member standing on its hind legs. The cute little animal stands guard on the fence of the children's clinic, bringing hope and smiles to recovering children.
szurikata_01.funFact: The statue was erected in cooperation with the Meerkat Foundation (an organization helping diabetic children) to draw attention to childhood type 1 diabetes.
szurikata_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Find Bókay János Street 51 in the 8th district.

Step 2 (Focus): Stop at the metal grate street fence of the 1st Department of Pediatrics.

Step 3 (Exact location): It stands on the stone base of the fence (standing guard), right near the entrance.

uzenet_01.name: Message (Putin and the Russian warship)
uzenet_01.description: A miniature Russian warship standing on a stone pedestal shaped like a middle finger. The title of the statue is: 'Message', reminding us of the famous act of resistance by the Ukrainian border guards of Snake Island.
uzenet_01.funFact: The statue is one of Mihály Kolodko's sharpest political statements against the war launched by Russia against Ukraine. After its erection, the statue made rounds in the international press worldwide.
uzenet_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Walk in the 13th district, on the section under the Pest bridgehead of Árpád Bridge.

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the Moscow Promenade, specifically the stone railing next to the asphalt road on the Danube bank.

Step 3 (Exact location): The ship stands on the stone-carved hand on top of one of the stone pillars of the railing.

szent_miklos_01.name: Lucky Saint Nicholas
szent_miklos_01.description: A tiny bronze statue of the lucky Saint Nicholas (patron saint of children and travelers), resting on the window sill of the cultural center with his sack of gifts.
szent_miklos_01.funFact: A belief quickly developed among locals that if you touch or stroke the statue of Saint Nicholas, it brings good luck in exams and in everyday life.
szent_miklos_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Travel to the 16th district (Sashalom), to Hunyadvár Street 43/c.

Step 2 (Focus): Stop at the main entrance of the Corvin Cultural Center.

Step 3 (Exact location): He rests on the outer sill of the ticket office (or information window).

chuck_norris_01.name: Tied-up Chuck Norris
chuck_norris_01.description: A mini-statue of the tied-up action hero Chuck Norris. The artwork humorously refers to the 2006 internet naming poll of the Megyeri Bridge, where the people of the internet voted for the bridge to be named after Chuck Norris.
chuck_norris_01.funFact: Although Chuck Norris won the vote, according to the law, a bridge could not be named after a living foreign person, so it eventually became the Megyeri Bridge. Kolodko placed the statue out on April Fool's Day (April 1st), and the action hero seems invincible even tied up.
chuck_norris_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Visit the Pest bridgehead of the Megyeri Bridge.

Step 2 (Focus): Walk up to the southern side of the bridge's pedestrian/bicycle path.

Step 3 (Exact location): He is tied to the massive metal support structure of the 'Pest' information glass plaque attached to the railing.

holdjaro_01.name: Lunar rover
holdjaro_01.location: Corner of Hold Street and Aulich Street
holdjaro_01.description: A mini-statue of a Lunar Roving Vehicle containing a tiny astronaut dressed in a spacesuit, parked on a concrete hemisphere symbolizing the Moon.
holdjaro_01.funFact: The statue has a double meaning: on the one hand, it is a tribute to Ferenc Pavlics, a NASA engineer of Hungarian descent who designed the wheels of the lunar rover, and on the other hand, it is a reference to Hold Street ('Moon' Street), where Kolodko first lived when moving to Budapest.
holdjaro_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Head to the 5th district, the corner of Hold Street and Aulich Street.

Step 2 (Focus): Stop at the street corner near the Batthyány Eternal Flame.

Step 3 (Exact location): It is parked on top of one of the concrete hemispheres (symbolizing the Moon) preventing street parking.

micimacko_01.name: Winnie the Pooh
micimacko_01.description: A mini-statue of Winnie the Pooh ('Silly old bear') eating from his honey pot, sitting by Frigyes Karinthy's memorial plaque on the house wall.
micimacko_01.funFact: The placement of the statue is a tribute to linguistic history: Milne's world-famous tale was rough-translated by Frigyes Karinthy's sister, Emília Karinthy (Mici), but Frigyes polished it into an immortal Hungarian literary masterpiece (and Pooh got his Hungarian name 'Micimackó' from her).
micimacko_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Walk to Damjanich Street 27 in the 7th district.

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the Karinthy memorial plaque on the wall of the house.

Step 3 (Exact location): He sits with his honey pot on the brick surface right below the memorial plaque, at eye level.

yoda_01.name: Master Yoda
yoda_01.description: A green mini-statue of Yoda, the wise Jedi master of the Star Wars universe, sitting in meditation on the metal railing of the metro underpass.
yoda_01.funFact: Yoda is a symbol of wisdom and inner strength. In the bustling, hurried world of the metro underpass, the statue encourages travelers to stop for a moment and find inner peace.
yoda_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Travel to Szent Gellért Square in the 11th district.

Step 2 (Focus): Go down into the bustling underpass of the M4 metro.

Step 3 (Exact location): He sits meditating on the lower part of the wide, metal dividing rail between the escalators leading to the surface.

paddington_01.name: Paddington and Masha's bear
paddington_01.description: Paddington bear, the British cartoon character, riding on the back of Masha's bear (the hero of the popular Russian cartoon series) on Medve ('Bear') Street.
paddington_01.funFact: The statue carries a satirical geopolitical message: Paddington bear's original British dubbing voice was the Ukrainian president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, during his acting career. The coexistence of the two bears reflects on the theme of war and peace.
paddington_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Visit Medve Street 5-7 in the 2nd district.

Step 2 (Focus): Stop in front of the entrance of the street-front office building / modern building.

Step 3 (Exact location): They are riding on the low stone ledge (on the edge of the flower bed) in front of the building.

leo_es_fred_01.name: Leo and Fred
leo_es_fred_01.description: Sándor Reisenbüchler and József Tóth's famous cartoon characters, Leo the lion and Fred the tamer, camping with a circus wagon on the bank of the Danube.
leo_es_fred_01.funFact: The statue commemorates the turn-of-the-century entertainment district of Lágymányosi Bay, the 'Little Constantinople', where circuses and nightclubs once entertained the Pest-Buda audience.
leo_es_fred_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Walk in BudaPart in the 11th district (Lágymányosi Bay).

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the waterfront promenade stretching where the greenery of the Kopaszi Dam meets the new residential park.

Step 3 (Exact location): They are located on the high stone wall (retaining wall) bordering the waterfront promenade, in the shade of the trees.

meditalo_nyul_01.name: Meditating rabbit (Zen bunny)
meditalo_nyul_01.description: A mini-statue of a bunny meditating in lotus position in complete Zen tranquility by the Danube stairs at the southern tip of Margaret Island.
meditalo_nyul_01.funFact: The statue is a humorous response to a previous, widely publicized 'rabbit attack' on Margaret Island, where overpopulated rabbits on the island caused alarm. The artist tamed the figure into an island of tranquility.
meditalo_nyul_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Walk down to the southernmost tip of Margaret Island.

Step 2 (Focus): South of the island entrance under Margaret Bridge, look for a yellow-painted set of stairs leading to the Danube.

Step 3 (Exact location): He meditates in lotus position at the very bottom / base of the yellow stairs leading to the water.

penzfujo_01.name: Money-blowing little man
penzfujo_01.description: A miniature man herding old pengő banknotes with a leaf blower. The statue commemorates the introduction of the forint in 1946 and the defeat of hyperinflation behind the Hungarian National Bank building.
penzfujo_01.funFact: Standing in front of the Hungarian National Bank building, the statue refers to the world's worst hyperinflation, when the value of the pengő halved in a matter of hours, and twenty-thousand-billion banknotes were swept on the streets.
penzfujo_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Head to the 5th district, the corner of Bank Street and Hold Street (the back of the Hungarian National Bank).

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the huge plane tree on the corner, surrounded by a black wrought-iron fence.

Step 3 (Exact location): The little man stands on the stone ledge of the fence surrounding the tree, and the tiny pengős are scattered on the stone in front of him.

targoncas_01.name: Forklift driver
targoncas_01.description: A miniature worker moving a stone block with his forklift in the vicinity of the disputed memorial.
targoncas_01.funFact: The statue was placed in Szabadság Square as a guerrilla action by Kolodko, as a reflection on the political and public memorial debates and constant alterations taking place in the square.
targoncas_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Walk in Szabadság Square in the 5th district.

Step 2 (Focus): Find the Memorial for Victims of the German Occupation and its huge stone base.

Step 3 (Exact location): He is pushing the stone block at the right corner of the memorial's base, on the ground level (sidewalk level).

hanti_vadas_01.name: Khanty hunter
hanti_vadas_01.description: A tiny bronze figure of a Finno-Ugric (Khanty) hunter carrying a deer on his shoulders at the foot of the bridge.
hanti_vadas_01.funFact: The statue draws attention to the Finno-Ugric roots of the Hungarian language and the ancient harmony with nature among the glass palaces and office buildings of the modern Infopark.
hanti_vadas_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Go to the 11th district, to the Buda bridgehead of Rákóczi Bridge.

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the pedestrian/bicycle ramp leading to the bridge opposite the MOL Campus tower building.

Step 3 (Exact location): He walks with the deer on top of the massive stone parapet accompanying the ramp.

pinokkio_01.name: Pinocchio
pinokkio_01.description: Pinocchio, the fairy tale hero whose nose grew due to lying, as a bronze mini-statue in Széchenyi István Square, on the stone wall of the tram 2 stop. The figure wears a graduation cap, creating a dialogue with the Hungarian Academy of Sciences in the background, reflecting on the irony of fake news, pseudoscience, and fibbing.
pinokkio_01.funFact: In the era of fake news, the statue is a symbol of the factual nature of science, the search for truth, and the spirit of the Academy.
pinokkio_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Visit Széchenyi István Square in the 5th district.

Step 2 (Focus): Go to the tram 2 stop (on the side of the Academy).

Step 3 (Exact location): The figure is wedged into one of the joints (recesses between stone blocks) of the stone retaining wall at the tram stop, hanging out of the wall by his long nose.

eredeti_usanka_01.name: Soviet Ushanka (Lost/Destroyed)
eredeti_usanka_01.description: The very first Soviet Ushanka mini-statue, which depicted a military hat in Szabadság Square.
eredeti_usanka_01.funFact: The statue caused a political storm: in January 2020, a Member of Parliament knocked it off the stone pillar with an axe and threw it into the Danube. Kolodko later replaced it with the 'Axe on a cushion' statue.
eredeti_usanka_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Szabadság Square, 5th district.

Step 2 (Focus): The fence surrounding the Soviet military memorial.

Step 3 (Exact location): The statue CAN NO LONGER BE FOUND at the location (it was thrown into the Danube, today the 'Axe on a cushion' statue can be seen in its place).

piszoar_01.name: Urinal (Marcel Duchamp) (Lost/Stolen)
piszoar_01.description: A miniature bronze version of Marcel Duchamp's famous Dadaist artwork ('Fountain' / Urinal).
piszoar_01.funFact: The statue referred to the roots of contemporary fine arts, but unfortunately, a few weeks after its placement, unknown persons illegally removed and stole it.
piszoar_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): City Park (Városliget), 14th district.

Step 2 (Focus): The promenades around Vajdahunyad Castle.

Step 3 (Exact location): The statue CAN NO LONGER BE FOUND at the location (stolen by unknown persons shortly after its placement).

eredeti_lisa_simpson_01.name: Lisa Simpson (Original) (Lost/Stolen)
eredeti_lisa_simpson_01.description: Lisa Simpson's very first Budapest mini-statue, which stood at the tram 2 stop.
eredeti_lisa_simpson_01.funFact: The statue was stolen from Jászai Mari Square shortly after its placement. Mihály Kolodko did not give up, but later placed a replacement statue in Fővám Square under the name 'Hungarian Yellow'.
eredeti_lisa_simpson_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Jászai Mari Square, 13th district.

Step 2 (Focus): The terminus of tram 2.

Step 3 (Exact location): The statue CAN NO LONGER BE FOUND at the location (it was stolen, but the artist placed a new one in Fővám Square).

dron_01.name: Drone / Swedish twist
dron_01.location: Bem Quay / Angelo Rotta Quay (near Margaret Bridge)
dron_01.description: A stylized bronze drone mini-statue with three crowns on top (referring to the coat of arms of Sweden). It reflects on modern technology and the world of military drones in a humorous way.
dron_01.funFact: The statue was previously on display at the Vác exhibition under the name Drone/Swedish twist. It 'landed' on the section of Bem Quay close to Margaret Bridge in the summer of 2025.
dron_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Go to Bem Quay, towards the Buda bridgehead of Margaret Bridge (Angelo Rotta Quay).

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the stone parapet near the tram stop.

Step 3 (Exact location): The drone is 'landing' on top of the parapet.

piszkos_fred_01.name: Dirty Fred, the Captain
piszkos_fred_01.location: Széchenyi István Square (next to the Hungarian Academy of Sciences)
piszkos_fred_01.description: A bronze mini-statue of Jenő Rejtő's (P. Howard) legendary novel hero, Captain Dirty Fred. With a pipe in his mouth, he sits casually on a travel trunk / sea chest on the Danube bank.
piszkos_fred_01.funFact: It was placed out at Christmas 2025. The choice of location is an intentional contrast: the iconic figure of Pest humor and pulp fiction appears at the foot of the HAS representing high culture.
piszkos_fred_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Go to Széchenyi István Square, to the building of the Hungarian Academy of Sciences.

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the Danube bank promenade / stone railing on the Academy's side.

Step 3 (Exact location): He sits on top of the trunk next to a stone element / pillar, in the direction of the Chain Bridge.

ii_erzsebet_01.name: Elizabeth II (Empire / Yellow Submarine)
ii_erzsebet_01.location: No longer in public space (Formerly: Millenáris Park)
ii_erzsebet_01.description: Queen Elizabeth II of Great Britain standing elegantly on top of a submarine, waving. The artwork refers to the Beatles song Yellow Submarine and the fact that the queen decorated the band members in 1965.
ii_erzsebet_01.funFact: The statue was originally placed temporarily in one of the ponds of Millenáris Park during Art Market Budapest in October 2024. As it was a guerrilla exhibition piece, it was later moved to Vác, to the Pannónia House for the 'Danube Shark' exhibition.
ii_erzsebet_01.howToFind:
ATTENTION: This statue is currently not visible in public space!

Step 1 (Area): Originally, it was at Building B of Millenáris Park (from Lövőház Street).

Step 2 (Focus): You had to look for the small pond next to Building B.

Step 3 (Exact location): It stood in the middle of the pond (it was a temporary placement).

veszprem_erno_01.name: Ernő, the guard
veszprem_erno_01.description: Ernő, the Guard of the Castle, symbolizes the historical past and protection in Veszprém. The statue wears the uniform of the Hungarian Royal Crown Guard, commemorating the fact that the Holy Crown and the Holy Right Hand were guarded in Veszprém for a month in 1944.
veszprem_erno_01.funFact: The statue was named after Crown Guard Commander Ernő Pajtás in a public vote. The letter 'B' on the statue's cap refers to the son of the client (the owner of A1-Sped Kft.) named Balázs.
veszprem_erno_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Visit Veszprém, the beginning of the historic Vár Street.

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the imposing Heroes' Gate marking the entrance to the Castle District.

Step 3 (Exact location): He stands guard at the base of the gate's western pillar, next to the stone wall.

veszprem_odon_01.name: Ödön, the street musician
veszprem_odon_01.description: Ödön, the street musician, commemorates the present age and Veszprém's vibrant musical life. The instrumental figure sitting on his suitcase is the symbol of the Veszprém Street Music Festival and the city's UNESCO 'City of Music' title.
veszprem_odon_01.funFact: The letter 'A' visible on the figure's cap indicates the initial of a family member named Andrea of the Veszprém entrepreneur who commissioned the statue.
veszprem_odon_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Walk in downtown Veszprém, on the pedestrian section of Kossuth Lajos Street.

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the area around the Hangvilla event center.

Step 3 (Exact location): By the street furniture, he sits on his suitcase on a low stone wall/curb.

veszprem_leonora_01.name: LeoNóra, the little girl and the lion
veszprem_leonora_01.description: LeoNóra, a little girl sitting on a lion's back tapping on a smartphone, represents the future, courage, and the peace of childhood. The statue also refers to Saint Margaret of the Árpád dynasty's childhood years in Veszprém.
veszprem_leonora_01.funFact: The letter 'T' visible on the little girl's chest is the initial of the client's third child (Tamás). The statue was placed in the immediate vicinity of the Margaret ruins.
veszprem_leonora_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Find the picturesque Kollégium Street in Veszprém.

Step 2 (Focus): Walk near the Margaret ruins, to the small bridge spanning over the Séd stream.

Step 3 (Exact location): She sits on the lion's back on the massive iron-stone railing of the bridge.

vac_anyam_tyukja_01.name: My Mother's Hen (Morzsa dog)
vac_anyam_tyukja_01.description: It depicts the main characters (Morzsa the dog and the mother hen) of Sándor Petőfi's iconic poem 'My Mother's Hen'. Petőfi wrote the poem in his parents' home in Vác, and the statue also evokes the poet's passion for train travel.
vac_anyam_tyukja_01.funFact: The placement of the statue is consciously linked to the railway: it was placed in the square in front of the Vác Railway Station, connecting Vác's literary memories with Hungarian railway history (the Pest-Vác line was the first Hungarian railway line).
vac_anyam_tyukja_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Travel to Vác, to Széchenyi Street 42. (Railway Station).

Step 2 (Focus): Stop at the open square in front of the main entrance of the Vác Railway Station.

Step 3 (Exact location): They sit next to each other on the rim of the raised stone/concrete flower bed decorating the square.

vac_maria_terezia_01.name: Maria Theresa's ecstasy
vac_maria_terezia_01.description: It captures a terrified, ecstatic moment of Queen Maria Theresa of Hungary. According to legend, during the monarch's visit to Vác in 1764, she did not dare to pass under the Triumphal Arch (Stone Gate) built in her honor in 2 weeks, because she was afraid it would collapse, so she clutched her heart.
vac_maria_terezia_01.funFact: The positioning of the mini-statue creates a perfect photo spot: if you look from the right angle, the original Triumphal Arch of Vác perfectly outlines in the background.
vac_maria_terezia_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Visit Vác, around the famous Stone Gate (Triumphal Arch).

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the small landscaped promenade next to the Triumphal Arch.

Step 3 (Exact location): She lies on top of a low metal/stone pillar (positioned so that the Triumphal Arch is visible in the background).

vac_csuzli_01.name: Slingshot (Ferenc Sajdik)
vac_csuzli_01.description: A mini-statue created in honor of Kossuth Prize-winning graphic artist and caricaturist Ferenc Sajdik, depicting a figure pulling a slingshot.
vac_csuzli_01.funFact: Ferenc Sajdik is connected to the city of Vác in a thousand ways: the Pannónia House standing on the main square houses the permanent collection and exhibition presenting the artist's life's work.
vac_csuzli_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Walk into the heart of Vác, to Március 15. Square (Main Square).

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the entrance of the Pannónia House (Sajdik Collection).

Step 3 (Exact location): He is pulling the slingshot on top of the carved stone pillar standing directly in front of the entrance.

vac_betoncapak_01.name: Concrete sharks (Danube sharks)
vac_betoncapak_01.description: The 'Concrete Sharks' statue group made using plastic and metal waste caught from the Danube river, created in an environmentally friendly way.
vac_betoncapak_01.funFact: The statue draws attention to environmental protection and the cleanliness of the Danube. It was created with the support of the Ignác Tragor Museum as an ecological art project.
vac_betoncapak_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Walk down to the Danube bank promenade in Vác.

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the more natural, stony/watery riverbank section next to the built promenade.

Step 3 (Exact location): The shark fins themselves are 'swimming' among the stones, partly in the water or right near the water level.

tihany_gomboc_artur_01.name: Arthur Dumpling
tihany_gomboc_artur_01.description: Arthur Dumpling, the chocolate-loving bird from István Csukás and Ferenc Sajdik's popular Pom Pom tale, with a Balaton chocolate bar in his wings.
tihany_gomboc_artur_01.funFact: One of the most popular countryside statues among tourists and children: visitors regularly leave real chocolates and sweets between Arthur Dumpling's claws.
tihany_gomboc_artur_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Visit Tihany, the famous Pisky Promenade.

Step 2 (Focus): Walk on the panoramic section between the Abbey and the Echo Hill.

Step 3 (Exact location): He sits on top of the basalt stone wall facing Lake Balaton, with chocolate in his claws.

szigliget_kempingezok_01.name: Balaton campers
szigliget_kempingezok_01.description: A mini-statue of a Volkswagen Golf camping car pulling a tiny caravan high on the castle wall.
szigliget_kempingezok_01.funFact: The statue evokes the golden age of Lake Balaton camping in the 70s and 80s and the retro holiday lifestyle on the rocks of the Szigliget castle.
szigliget_kempingezok_01.howToFind:
ATTENTION: The statue is on the top level of the castle, so it can ONLY be visited during the opening hours of the Szigliget Castle and with a valid entrance ticket!

Step 1 (Area): Climb up to the Szigliget Castle (with a purchased ticket).

Step 2 (Focus): Go up to the top level of the castle, to the viewpoint of the Benedictine tower.

Step 3 (Exact location): The little car is 'parked' on top of the stone wall of the tower facing Badacsony, which provides a view.

hortobagy_csontvary_01.name: Tivadar Csontváry Kosztka
hortobagy_csontvary_01.description: A mini-statue of the painter Tivadar Csontváry Kosztka, creating with a spray paint can in the middle of the puszta.
hortobagy_csontvary_01.funFact: It commemorates Csontváry's famous painting 'Storm on the Hortobágy'. The statue is part of Kolodko's international Csontváry series (Munich, Mostar, Hortobágy).
hortobagy_csontvary_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Travel to the Hortobágy, to the center of the Puszta.

Step 2 (Focus): Walk up to the famous, monument Nine-holed Bridge.

Step 3 (Exact location): He is walking on the brick parapet (stone railing) of the bridge, turning towards the endless puszta.

esztergom_pumukli_01.name: Pumuckl
esztergom_pumukli_01.description: A mini-statue of Pumuckl, the mischievous red-haired goblin, hiding in the recess of a stone wall.
esztergom_pumukli_01.funFact: The reason for the choice of location: Pumuckl's unforgettable Hungarian dubbing voice, actor Kornél Pusztaszeri, was born in the city of Esztergom.
esztergom_pumukli_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Walk on the charming Kis-Duna Promenade in Esztergom.

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the area next to the building of the Saint Elizabeth High School and the high stone wall.

Step 3 (Exact location): He sits in one of the open recesses/holes of the massive stone wall.

gyula_lo_01.name: Horse in the pool
gyula_lo_01.description: A miniature bronze horse bathing in thermal water in the indoor hall of the spa.
gyula_lo_01.funFact: The statue commemorates the former Riding Hall building of the Gyula Castle Spa, where the horses of the Almásy counts once stood, and today a thermal pool operates in it.
gyula_lo_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Visit Gyula, to the Gyula Castle Spa (Attention: INDOOR statue, only accessible with a spa ticket!).

Step 2 (Focus): Inside the spa, find the indoor Riding Hall building.

Step 3 (Exact location): The tiny bronze horse bathes directly in the water/edge of one of the historical thermal pools.

nyirbator_sohordo_01.name: Salt merchant (Nyírbátor)
nyirbator_sohordo_01.description: A salt merchant mini-statue carrying a salt barrel on his back, paying tribute to the memory of the Historical Salt Route.
nyirbator_sohordo_01.funFact: This statue is part of a cross-border sculpture route consisting of 5 Hungarian and 5 Transcarpathian pieces, marking the medieval Transylvanian salt transport route.
nyirbator_sohordo_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Visit the center of Nyírbátor, the City History Promenade.

Step 2 (Focus): Walk on the renovated, paved main square areas around the benches and street furniture.

Step 3 (Exact location): He is walking on one of the low stone benches / retaining walls with the salt barrel on his back.

nagykallo_sohordo_01.name: Salt merchant (Nagykálló)
nagykallo_sohordo_01.description: A salt merchant mini-statue carrying a salt barrel on his back, paying tribute to the memory of the Historical Salt Route.
nagykallo_sohordo_01.funFact: This statue is part of a cross-border sculpture route consisting of 5 Hungarian and 5 Transcarpathian pieces, marking the medieval Transylvanian salt transport route.
nagykallo_sohordo_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Go to the heart of Nagykálló, to the Main Square.

Step 2 (Focus): Observe the paved central landscaped areas and public elements.

Step 3 (Exact location): He carries the salt barrel on one of the low stone benches / decorative pavements.

vasarosnameny_sohordo_01.name: Salt merchant (Vásárosnamény)
vasarosnameny_sohordo_01.location: Vásárosnamény, Park in front of the City Hall
vasarosnameny_sohordo_01.description: A salt merchant mini-statue carrying a salt barrel on his back, paying tribute to the memory of the Historical Salt Route.
vasarosnameny_sohordo_01.funFact: This statue is part of a cross-border sculpture route consisting of 5 Hungarian and 5 Transcarpathian pieces, marking the medieval Transylvanian salt transport route.
vasarosnameny_sohordo_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Head to the center of Vásárosnamény, the park in front of the City Hall.

Step 2 (Focus): Walk along the well-kept paths of the park, paying attention to the borders and resting places.

Step 3 (Exact location): The small bronze figure is located on a stone-paved curb or retaining wall.

csenger_sohordo_01.name: Salt merchant (Csenger)
csenger_sohordo_01.description: A salt merchant mini-statue carrying a salt barrel on his back, paying tribute to the memory of the Historical Salt Route.
csenger_sohordo_01.funFact: This statue is part of a cross-border sculpture route consisting of 5 Hungarian and 5 Transcarpathian pieces, marking the medieval Transylvanian salt transport route.
csenger_sohordo_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Visit the center of Csenger decorated with Makovecz-style buildings.

Step 2 (Focus): Walk along the stone pavements of the central squares and promenades.

Step 3 (Exact location): He stands on one of the low stone curbs, commemorating the historical salt route.

tiszabecs_sohordo_01.name: Salt merchant (Tiszabecs)
tiszabecs_sohordo_01.description: A salt merchant mini-statue carrying a salt barrel on his back, paying tribute to the memory of the Historical Salt Route.
tiszabecs_sohordo_01.funFact: This statue is part of a cross-border sculpture route consisting of 5 Hungarian and 5 Transcarpathian pieces, marking the medieval Transylvanian salt transport route.
tiszabecs_sohordo_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Travel to the border settlement of Tiszabecs.

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the center of the village or the memorials close to the bank of the Tisza river.

Step 3 (Exact location): He carries the heavy salt barrel on his back on a low stone pedestal or curb.

geszteredi_csardas_01.name: Geszteréd triple csárdás
geszteredi_csardas_01.location: Geszteréd, Kossuth Street (at the memorial site)
geszteredi_csardas_01.description: Mihály Kolodko's mini-statue commemorates the famous triple csárdás of Geszteréd. The statue forms three figures dancing the traditional Hungarian dance, the csárdás. The artwork was created through the collaboration of the local community with the aim of preserving traditions.
geszteredi_csardas_01.funFact: The statue is accompanied by a marble plaque with the thoughts of local lead violinist János Keserű. A 1955 archive film recording of the steps of the Geszteréd triple csárdás also survived, which inspired the artwork.
geszteredi_csardas_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): In the center of Geszteréd, look around the area of Fő Street and Kossuth Street.

Step 2 (Focus): Look for a nicely designed small memorial site with a granite/marble pedestal.

Step 3 (Exact location): The three dancing tiny bronze figures spin on this stone pedestal on their own little stage.

kallay_janos_peter_01.name: Count János Péter Kállay
kallay_janos_peter_01.description: An artwork commemorating the founder of Biri, Count János Péter Kállay of Nagykálló (1735–1810), which is part of the 'Count's Library' statue group. The composition consists of 12 large, carved stone books (the work of stone sculptor György Sárga), on one of which sits the miniature bronze statue of the count created by Kolodko.
kallay_janos_peter_01.funFact: The count was considered extremely educated even by 18th-century standards. He had a huge library in the mansion that now functions as the village hall, and he read the French encyclopedists in their original language. That is why the statue depicts him on top of a library.
kallay_janos_peter_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Go to the settlement of Biri and find Sport Street.

Step 2 (Focus): Next to the local football pitch and sports facility, examine the green area.

Step 3 (Exact location): Look for the huge stone books lying on the ground! Next to the eleven lying books, there is one standing, and the mini-statue sits on top of it.

munich_csontvary_01.name: Tivadar Csontváry Kosztka
munich_csontvary_01.description: A mini-statue of the painter Tivadar Csontváry Kosztka in Munich, creating as a graffiti artist with a spray paint can in his hand in the Bavarian capital.
munich_csontvary_01.funFact: The statue is the exact twin brother of the Csontváry statue located at the Nine-holed Bridge in Hortobágy. Csontváry began his artistic studies in Munich at Simon Hollósy's free school.
munich_csontvary_01.howToFind: Step 1: Walk in downtown Munich on Prinzregentenstraße towards the area of the Angel of Peace (Friedensengel) monument. Step 2: Look for the stone railing of the stepped terrace. Step 3: The bronze statue is placed on the stone parapet at the height of passers-by.

munich_pumukli_01.name: Pumuckl
munich_pumukli_01.description: A mini-statue of the most famous and lovable mischievous goblin of Bavarian-German television, Pumuckl.
munich_pumukli_01.funFact: Kolodko hid the statue in Munich in 2022, paying tribute to the famous storybook and TV series set in Munich (Master Eder and his Pumuckl).
munich_pumukli_01.howToFind: Step 1: In the city of Munich, it's worth keeping your eyes open around the stone walls and bridge edges of the Isar River. Step 2: Look for the tiny bronze goblin with his characteristically messy hair.

munich_oktoberfest_01.name: Oktoberfest (A toast to the Oktoberfest!)
munich_oktoberfest_01.description: A bronze hand reaching out of the asphalt, holding a traditional Bavarian beer mug up high.
munich_oktoberfest_01.funFact: The artist placed the statue at the site of the world's largest beer festival, the Theresienwiese, in 2020 (unfortunately, according to news, it has since been damaged multiple times or has disappeared).
munich_oktoberfest_01.howToFind: Step 1: Visit the huge, open square of the Theresienwiese in Munich. Step 2: Look for the statue 'reaching out' from a crack in the concrete/asphalt.

landshut_rakoczi_01.name: Francis II Rákóczi (Landshut)
landshut_rakoczi_01.description: A tiny bronze statue of Prince Francis II Rákóczi resting comfortably by a spring in Landshut, Bavaria.
landshut_rakoczi_01.funFact: The statue was placed next to the local Rákóczi Spring (Rákóczi-Quelle) in 2020. The spring is connected to Hungarian history, the Kuruc soldiers who once passed through here, and the Prince.
landshut_rakoczi_01.howToFind: Step 1: Visit the 'Am Schallermoos' street in the city of Landshut. Step 2: Walk to the water of the Rákóczi Spring (Rákóczi-Quelle). Step 3: The statue sits on the stones around the water spout.

nuremberg_ajtosi_01.name: Adalbert Ajtósi (Albrecht Dürer the Elder)
nuremberg_ajtosi_01.description: A miniature monument to the goldsmith father (Adalbert Ajtósi) of the famous German painter Albrecht Dürer.
nuremberg_ajtosi_01.funFact: Kolodko created the statue in 2021 for the 550th anniversary of Adalbert Ajtósi's birth. The name is no coincidence: the Dürer family originally came from the settlement of Ajtós (German 'Türer' -> Dürer) near Gyula.
nuremberg_ajtosi_01.howToFind:
ATTENTION: The statue is in the inner courtyard of the museum, so it can only be visited during the opening hours of the Tucher Castle!

Step 1 (Area): Visit the historic center of Nuremberg, to the Tucher Castle (Museum Tucherschloss).

Step 2 (Focus): Enter the open inner courtyard of the museum.

Step 3 (Exact location): The statue welcomes you on one of the stone surfaces of the castle courtyard.

prague_rakoczi_01.name: Francis II Rákóczi
prague_rakoczi_01.description: A mini-statue depicting the young Prince Francis II Rákóczi.
prague_rakoczi_01.funFact: It commemorates the Prince's student years in Prague (1691–1692). The little statue was inaugurated with the help of the Liszt Institute in Prague, essentially complementing the existing Rákóczi memorial plaque already there.
prague_rakoczi_01.howToFind: Step 1: In Prague, set off to the Lesser Town Square (Malostranské náměstí). Step 2: Look for the building of the former Jesuit college. Step 3: The tiny bronze figure is located in the immediate vicinity of the Rákóczi memorial plaque fixed to the wall, on the wall or on its edge.

vienna_alex_delarge_01.name: Alex DeLarge (A Clockwork Orange)
vienna_alex_delarge_01.description: A mini-statue of the sociopathic protagonist of the cult Stanley Kubrick film 'A Clockwork Orange' (Alex, played by Malcolm McDowell), with his cane and bowler hat.
vienna_alex_delarge_01.funFact: In the film and book, Alex was a fanatic fan of Beethoven's music (he only called him 'lovely lovely Ludwig van'). Therefore, with brilliant ingenuity, Kolodko placed him right on the pedestal of the Beethoven monument in Vienna in 2023.
vienna_alex_delarge_01.howToFind: Step 1: Walk to Beethovenplatz near the Stadtpark in Vienna. Step 2: Stop at the gigantic 19th-century Beethoven monument towering in the middle of the square. Step 3: You will find the statue on the left stone blocking the stairs in front of the main monument.

venice_selfie_01.name: Selfie in Venice
venice_selfie_01.description: The statue depicts the winged lion of St. Mark, or a typical tourist wearing flippers, taking a picture of himself over the canal with a selfie stick.
venice_selfie_01.funFact: The artwork holds a distorted mirror to modern, superficial mass tourism. Unfortunately, according to news, the artwork disappeared from its original place in 2024, so it probably fell prey to someone.
venice_selfie_01.howToFind: Step 1: Visit the Santa Maria della Pietà church. Step 2: Step onto the port side section in front of the church. Step 3: The statue originally photographed itself towards the sea on the stones here, today (since 2024) you will only find its empty place.

pula_legionarius_01.name: In vino veritas (Roman legionary)
pula_legionarius_01.description: A mini-statue of a Roman legionary soldier resting carelessly with an amphora, intoxicated by wine, at the foot of the ancient amphitheater.
pula_legionarius_01.funFact: The statue is an exact replica of the Roman soldier statue in Óbuda, Budapest. The two artworks form a kind of invisible historical bridge between the two former Roman provinces.
pula_legionarius_01.howToFind: Step 1: Visit the famous Roman amphitheater (Pula Arena) in the center of Pula. Step 2: Walk along the outer, ruined stone walls of the building. Step 3: The mini-statue lies in the grass among the stones of the walls.

rijeka_piszkos_fred_01.name: Knife in the sailor (Dirty Fred, the Captain)
rijeka_piszkos_fred_01.description: An artwork immortalizing the very first scene of Jenő Rejtő's novel. A sailor is painted on the wall (graffiti), with a real, miniature bronze knife sticking out of his back.
rijeka_piszkos_fred_01.funFact: The statue refers to the cult opening line of Hungarian pulp fiction ('– Sir! I came for my knife! / – Where did you leave it? / – In some sailor.'). Kolodko thus smuggled Pest humor to the coast.
rijeka_piszkos_fred_01.howToFind: Step 1: Walk in the port of Rijeka (Rijeka Luka) or on the downtown streets close to the sea. Step 2: Look for a wall section where a sailor graphic is drawn with simple black lines. Step 3: The pearl-handled dagger planted in his back is a tangible, physical mini-statue.

rijeka_carpathia_01.name: RMS Carpathia steamship
rijeka_carpathia_01.description: A mini-statue immortalizing the lifebuoy of the RMS Carpathia ocean liner that saved the survivors of the Titanic.
rijeka_carpathia_01.funFact: The Carpathia set sail from Fiume (Rijeka) with a Hungarian crew before the fatal night, and Europe's only original Titanic lifebuoy is exhibited in the maritime museum of Rijeka. This tiny artwork placed in 2024 pays tribute to this.
rijeka_carpathia_01.howToFind: Step 1: Go to the coastal port promenade of Rijeka. Step 2: Watch the joints of the thick stone walls and piers running along the shore. Step 3: The bronze-cast lifebuoy anchors stylishly on the stones.

lendva_lecso_01.name: Cauldron (Ratatouille)
lendva_lecso_01.description: The figure of Remy, the well-known gastro-rat from the Pixar tale, holding a wooden spoon while working at a graffiti reading 'Bogrács' (Cauldron).
lendva_lecso_01.funFact: Lendava is known for its famous Bogrács Festival, so Kolodko created the twin brother of the Budapest Ratatouille statue here in 2022 in honor of the local culinary arts.
lendva_lecso_01.howToFind: Step 1: Visit downtown Lendava, around the local Gallery-Museum and theater. Step 2: Look for a modern retaining wall with the word 'Bogrács' sprayed on it. Step 3: The little bronze rat sits on the ledge right in front of the inscription.

mostar_csontvary_01.name: Tivadar Csontváry Kosztka (Mostar)
mostar_csontvary_01.description: A mini-statue of Csontváry depicting the painting genius as he conjures his spirit in the Balkan city with a spray paint can.
mostar_csontvary_01.funFact: Csontváry painted his iconic masterpiece 'Roman Bridge in Mostar' here in 1903. Kolodko placed the statue out in the summer of 2023 for the 170th anniversary of the painting giant's birth.
mostar_csontvary_01.howToFind: Step 1: Visit Mostar's iconic landmark, the Old Bridge (Stari Most). Step 2: Descend to the bank of the Neretva River towards the southern (lower) downstream direction of the bridge, on the bank closer to the Croatian side. Step 3: You will find the statue on one of the waterfront rocks about a hundred meters from the Old Bridge.

stockholm_nobel_01.name: Alfred Nobel
stockholm_nobel_01.description: A tiny bronze statue sculpting the portrait of Alfred Nobel, the inventor of dynamite and the founder of the world-famous scientific prize.
stockholm_nobel_01.funFact: In proportion to its population, Hungary boasts one of the highest numbers of Nobel laureate scientists, so the statue was born as a symbol of Swedish-Hungarian cultural and scientific respect.
stockholm_nobel_01.howToFind: Step 1: Head to the diplomatic district of Östermalm in Stockholm, specifically the building at Dag Hammarskjölds väg 10. Step 2: Find the wrought-iron fence of the Hungarian Embassy. Step 3: The statue is located directly on the street-front fence.

stockholm_karlsson_01.name: Karlsson-on-the-Roof (MiniKarlsson)
stockholm_karlsson_01.description: Astrid Lindgren's tale hero, Karlsson flying with a propeller on his back, with a modern twist: holding a drone remote control in his hand and wearing VR goggles on his head.
stockholm_karlsson_01.funFact: Kolodko catapulted the traditional Swedish tale hero into the 21st century, and placed the statue at one of Stockholm's most beautiful viewpoints overlooking the sea in 2023.
stockholm_karlsson_01.howToFind: Step 1: Go up to the Södermalm district of Stockholm, to Fjällgatan street. Step 2: Walk to the area of Fjällgatan 44, to the terrace of the viewpoint. Step 3: The figure sits on the thick stone ledge.

istanbul_barabas_01.name: Barabás (The Paul Street Boys)
istanbul_barabas_01.description: A bronze statue depicting one of the characters from Ferenc Molnár's novel, Barabás, who is sitting right on the huge, stone-carved seal of the Putty Club.
istanbul_barabas_01.funFact: One of the latest foreign works: it was unveiled in January 2026 during the Hungarian-Turkish Cultural Season. The novel is compulsory reading in Turkey, so the locals also welcomed it with great joy.
istanbul_barabas_01.howToFind: Step 1: Look for the local Liszt Institute near Istanbul's bustling pedestrian street, Istiklal Caddesi (Beyoğlu district). Step 2: Above the information board with a QR code placed on the street front, the statue sits on a wall section / pillar.

seoul_liszt_01.name: Ferenc Liszt (Seoul)
seoul_liszt_01.description: A mini-statue of composer Ferenc Liszt in Seoul, sitting on a suitcase waiting.
seoul_liszt_01.funFact: Hungarian classical music has a huge cult following in South Korea. This statue is an exact replica of the Liszt statue located at the Budapest airport (number 4 by serial number), with which Kolodko also gifted the Asian audience.
seoul_liszt_01.howToFind: Step 1: Visit the local Hungarian Cultural Center (Liszt Institute) in downtown Seoul. Step 2: The statue rests on the stone bench/pedestal next to the entrance of the institute.

princeton_einstein_01.name: Albert Einstein
princeton_einstein_01.description: A mini-statue of physicist Albert Einstein in Princeton, pondering the mysteries of the universe while sitting on a stone bench.
princeton_einstein_01.funFact: This is the artist's first public mini-statue in America. Einstein spent the last more than twenty years of his life at Princeton University, and Kolodko took this memorial to him in 2019.
princeton_einstein_01.howToFind: Step 1: Travel to the Princeton University campus, New Jersey. Step 2: Visit the promenades of Marquand Park opposite the former Einstein house. Step 3: The statue sits on one of the resting stone benches/low pedestals.

freddie_montserrat_01.name: Freddie Mercury and Montserrat Caballé
freddie_montserrat_01.description: A paired mini-statue commemorating the legendary frontman of Queen, Freddie Mercury, and the world-famous Spanish opera singer, Montserrat Caballé. The duo made history with the iconic song of the 1992 Barcelona Olympics (Barcelona).
freddie_montserrat_01.funFact: Kolodko placed the statues in Spain in January 2026 as part of a real guerrilla action, quietly securing them to the railing of stone stairs. Freddie is shown with a clenched fist, and Montserrat with spread arms and in a cape.
freddie_montserrat_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): In Barcelona, head to the Montjuïc hill, specifically the area of the Magic Fountain (Font Màgica) and the CaixaForum.

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the old, rustic stone stairs leading towards the buildings.

Step 3 (Exact location): You must look for the two tiny statues facing each other on the wide, stone-built railing of one of the stone stairs.

svejk_olomouc_01.name: Švejk, the good soldier (Olomouc)
svejk_olomouc_01.description: A miniature bronze replica of the famous Czech soldier, Švejk, in the city of Olomouc. The figure, peacefully holding a dumpling instead of a weapon, was placed in front of the 'U Kuděje' pub in 2016. The choice of location is no accident: Czech writer Matěj Kuděj was a close friend and drinking buddy of Jaroslav Hašek (Švejk's creator).
svejk_olomouc_01.funFact: The statue is so tiny and blends into its environment so well next to the pub's terrace that locals say only those who are already heading inside purposefully for a good pint of beer notice it.
svejk_olomouc_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Walk towards the Čechovy sady (Czech Park) on Krapkova Street in Olomouc.

Step 2 (Focus): Find the popular local pub called 'U Kuděje'.

Step 3 (Exact location): The statue sits outside, on the simple metal railing next to the entrance/sidewalk.

svejk_lipnice_01.name: Švejk, the good soldier (Lipnice)
svejk_lipnice_01.description: Kolodko's Švejk clone in the Czech village where Jaroslav Hašek spent the last years of his life, where he wrote most of the novel, and where his grave is located. The statue was inaugurated under the local Hašek memorial plaque in 2017.
svejk_lipnice_01.funFact: The plaque of the statuette's pedestal reads in several languages: 'Soldier Josef Švejk – the messenger of peace'. The statue was jointly erected by Kolodko and the international Hašek Society.
svejk_lipnice_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Visit the center of Lipnice nad Sázavou in the Czech Republic.

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the Hašek monument and the famous inn called 'U České koruny' (At the Czech Crown), which once belonged to Hašek.

Step 3 (Exact location): The bronze figure was placed in the immediate vicinity of the memorial plaque and inscriptions.

svejk_humenne_01.name: Švejk, the good soldier (Humenné)
svejk_humenne_01.description: A mini-statue of the good soldier in Humenné, Slovakia. The settlement plays an important role in the novel: Švejk and his unit passed through here heading towards the Eastern Front. Kolodko's mini-statue pays tribute to the famous 'Humenné stop'.
svejk_humenne_01.funFact: In Humenné, fans of the novel had already erected a large Švejk statue (next to a well), but Kolodko's 'guerrilla' dumpling Švejk is a much tinier, more hidden surprise for travelers arriving by train.
svejk_humenne_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Go towards the Humenné railway station (Železničná stanica Humenné).

Step 2 (Focus): Examine the metal railings and pillars around the platforms and the station building.

Step 3 (Exact location): The little Švejk sits with his luggage (and dumpling) on one of the metal pipes of the railway infrastructure.

svejk_przemysl_01.name: Švejk, the good soldier (Przemyśl)
svejk_przemysl_01.description: Švejk's mini-statue in Poland. Przemyśl is a key location in the book: according to the story, our hero accidentally put on an abandoned Russian uniform on the riverbank, causing the Austro-Hungarian troops to mistake him for a Russian spy and capture him in the fortress city.
svejk_przemysl_01.funFact: A life-size Švejk sitting on an ammunition box has been in the main square of Przemyśl for a long time, but Kolodko's messenger of peace, the mini-statue with the dumpling, arrived in the city in the spirit of Polish-Hungarian-Ukrainian friendship.
svejk_przemysl_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Head to the historic center of Przemyśl and the bank of the San River.

Step 2 (Focus): Look for the memorials of the old fortress system or the railings around the main square (Rynek).

Step 3 (Exact location): The peaceful, smiling figure sits on a metal element resembling a gun barrel.

svejk_kielce_01.name: Švejk, the good soldier (Kielce)
svejk_kielce_01.description: Another Kolodko-style Švejk clone in Poland. The statue was handed over in a ceremonial setting in June 2017, in close cooperation with the local Society of Švejk Fans, which actively cultivates the memory of the peaceful Czech soldier of World War I.
svejk_kielce_01.funFact: Jaroslav Hašek's descendants also attended the inauguration. This statue is also part of the network of 'brother statues' in Ukraine (Uzhhorod), and similarly holds a dumpling in his hand instead of a weapon.
svejk_kielce_01.howToFind:
Step 1 (Area): Search in the city center of Kielce, in the catchment area of the pedestrian streets.

Step 2 (Focus): Find a metal or stone pedestal with a memorial plaque where local literary/historical associations usually meet.

Step 3 (Exact location): The bronze miniature sits above an inscribed plaque (Wojak Józef Szwejk – poslaniec pokoju).
